theorems.name: Submission.gte_graph_image_geometry
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), Continuous (fun p : Rn n × Rn ℓ => graphPoint p.1 p.2) ∧ Continuous (fun z : Amb n ℓ => (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm z)).1) ∧ (∀ (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm (q (graphPoint x y)))).1 = x) ∧ ∀ (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (R r : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (closedBall 0 R) → r ≤ R → IsCompact (q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 R)) ∧ MeasurableSet (q '' graphOver f (ball 0 r))
